description: Public Service Commission - Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission to the Public Officers in Relavant to the Subject of Health in terms of Article 57(1) and to the Health Service Committee in terms of Article 56(1) of the Constitutuion that shall come into force w.e.f. 01.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission for matters including disciplinary control, transfers, appointments, and promotions of public officers in the health sector. It deals specifically with public service administration, recruitment, and service conditions, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
